name: Stollhofer
beschreibung:
History

The website presents the house as Restaurant zum Stollhofer and as hotel, restaurant and apartment. In the contact block it says Gasthof zum Stollhofer, Familie Markt, Salzstraße 6, 6401 Inzing, telephone +43 5238 88119, email office@gasthof-stollhofer.at. A founding year or a chronicle of innkeepers is not published on the homepage retrieved. One of the parlours is called Andreas-Hofer-Stube. That is a room name and not evidence that Andreas Hofer was in this house. The kitchen describes itself as a Tyrolean inn with freshly prepared dishes from products of local agriculture and of the surrounding waters and woods. With the „Bewusst Tirol“ coin the house commits itself to using products from surrounding regions or from Österreich. Dishes are also available to take away.

Getting there

The published address is Salzstraße 6, 6401 Inzing. A description of train, bus or parking spaces is not on the page retrieved. Table reservations and the planning of celebrations go through +43 5238 88119. Which stop is the nearest, the page does not say.

Tips

Guests can sit in various parlours, in the restaurant or in the guest garden. For celebrations, seminars and meetings the page names the Zirbenstube with 14 people, the Andreas-Hofer-Stube with 28 people, the Gaststube with 40 people, the Stollhofer-Stube with 25 people and the restaurant with 32 people. The consumptions of the house guests are written onto the room bill. The page thereby confirms that there are house guests and rooms. Room sizes, apartment prices and a number of beds are not on the homepage retrieved.

The kitchen has a closure from 26 October to 2 November 2026 and from 13 November to 6 December 2026. Outside these times: Friday to Tuesday 18:00 to 20:30, Sunday additionally 11:30 to 13:30. The breakfast buffet is not intended only for house guests. Named are a glass of sparkling wine, numerous kinds of bread including a homemade wholemeal bread, cake, variations of sausage and cheese, fresh vegetables and fruit, sweet pastries, homemade jams, a large selection of teas and coffee variations. The house advertises itself as a place for baptisms, first communion, confirmation, birthdays and other family celebrations.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof zum Stollhofer of the Markt family at Salzstraße 6 in Inzing, with a restaurant, parlours for celebrations and a breakfast buffet.
